_doc: T-136: the savings bank (BankAccount, BankLedger, BankBranch, BankCounter, BankCard). Deposit Scrip at a branch; the balance is kept in your profile between matches and earns interest_per_round (1%) at the start of every round you play, on any map (rounded down, at least min_interest while there is anything in it), up to max_balance. Withdraw it at a branch in any later match. Off in Classic Rules and online (the counter is shut, no interest). Moving Scrip in or out is no earning: it never counts toward stats, challenges or power-up drops (Economy.bank_move). Branches: the Crossroads' woodshed, now the village Darlehenskasse (gen_map00 build_bank_shed), and the pay office in Kaltenbrunn's administration block. A branch is set in its own frame: at = the counter's centre on the floor, yaw = where the customers' side faces (deg: 0 = +z, 90 = +x, 180 = -z); local x along the counter.
